summary: The first v44 Magicbane mismatch is a missing production call from artifact.c:Mb_hit to the already implemented zap.c:probe_monster. When a hero hits a hostile monster with a +0 Magicbane and the MB_INDEX_PROBE branch is selected, C prints the insight message and then reports the target status and inventory. JavaScript stops at note_unported("zap.c probe_monster"), so the target status page and subsequent no-inventory message are absent. The first screen and cursor mismatch is step 103; the C and JavaScript RNG streams agree for all 5192 expected calls before JavaScript makes one later extra call after the input/page sequence diverges.

source.branch: The hero hits a hostile monster with Magicbane through artifact_hit, the AD_STUN artifact dispatch accepts the hit (dieroll <= MB_MAX_DIEROLL), and Mb_hit selects MB_INDEX_PROBE. In the selected case Magicbane has spe == 0, so the youattack probe condition succeeds without another random draw.
callers: artifact.c:artifact_hit dispatches to Mb_hit when the weapon attacks with AD_STUN and dieroll <= MB_MAX_DIEROLL.
uhitm.c:hmon calls artifact_hit for the hero melee hit exercised by the selected recording.
JavaScript production path: uhitm.js:hmon -> artifacts.js:artifact_hit -> Mb_hit.
dependencies: zap.c:probe_monster and its local probe_objchain are already implemented canonically in js/zap.js; Mb_hit still skips the call through note_unported.
zap.c:probe_monster calls insight.c:mstatusline before its inventory or no-inventory branch; those existing owners supply the output.

evidence: The authoritative saved combined queue has SHA-256 4d2fbb59ee38299c0fff283a3597d92083fcb640c66fdefac7c3de55ba5545ab. Its v44 entry uses manifest membership hash 4eb8b2949c1c27ac716c7914f50df8f84e883a415fd05262428c2743f75841d0, recording hash 168c9c11c7f79122b1ec2127268b84726de65285d4542715bfbffbe001fc95ed, and baseline evaluation challenges/evaluations/v44-baseline-542873573.json at 5428735736684d2c3a4a286d3a124f2887dfb547. It records 103/108 matching screens, 5192/5192 matching RNG calls, 104/108 matching cursors, and five remaining screens.

The queue locates the first mismatch at segment 0, step 103, on the space input: C has a dash at row 0, column 24 while JavaScript has a space; C cursor is [32,0,1] and JavaScript cursor is [58,18,1]. The queue reports JavaScript rn2(20)=16 as an extra call at RNG index 5192, after the expected C stream has ended.

The admitted C recording challenges/cases/v44/v44-magicbane-monster-probe-cfirst.session.json confirms the source order: step 102 attacks with the magic-absorbing blade probing the stone giant; its Mb_hit draws are rn2(11)=0 and rnd(4)=1. Since spe is zero, rn2(11)=0 makes do_stun false and leaves MB_INDEX_PROBE selected. Step 103 shows “The probe is insightful.--More--”; step 105 shows “Status of the stone giant ...” with another More prompt; step 107 reports that the giant is not carrying anything.

Upstream artifact.c:Mb_hit selects MB_INDEX_PROBE and calls probe_monster after the insight message (lines 1381-1386). artifact.c:artifact_hit dispatches Magicbane to Mb_hit at its AD_STUN and dieroll guard; uhitm.c:hmon reaches artifact_hit at lines 1015-1016.

JavaScript artifacts.js:Mb_hit emits the insight message and then calls note_unported("zap.c probe_monster") at lines 1907-1913. Its artifact_hit already dispatches to Mb_hit at lines 2100-2104, and uhitm.js:hmon is the selected hero-melee production caller at lines 2793-2796.

The callee is already implemented: zap.c:probe_monster calls mstatusline first, then either probes and displays minventory or prints the no-inventory message (lines 625-640); local probe_objchain is at lines 612-623. js/zap.js has the matching probe_objchain at lines 1005-1016 and probe_monster at lines 3293-3313. scripts/zapyourself.test.mjs already pins the long-worm status-before-return behavior. The missing work is to complete the whole artifact.c:Mb_hit function by wiring this canonical callee, not to port zap.c again.

The source-based task kind is file-port because Mb_hit contains an explicit missing C call, rather than an incorrect implementation of the called probe behavior. Keep the implementation scope to the whole artifact.c:Mb_hit function and its existing production path; use scripts/artifacts.test.mjs for focused caller coverage. The admitted v44 range can provide runtime evidence after the corrected replay matches.
